name: Envirotemp™ FR3™
summary: A bio-based natural-ester transformer fluid with flash and fire points of about 330 °C and 360 °C. Cargill states it contains no petroleum, halogens, silicones or corrosive sulfur. This record is incomplete: only the values checked so far are shown, and the full typical-property table is still being verified.

pfas.quote: It does not contain petroleum, halogens, silicones or corrosive sulfur.
pfas.note: No halogens means no fluorine, so no PFAS.
